summary: Phase 1 owner setup completion. Four setup states derived from selected dog data on owner home: no-dog (existing), no-walker (existing), walker-with-zero-price (NEW), setup-complete (NEW calm state). Set-price action already exists in dashboard/actions.ts (setPriceAction). Price not exposed in DogWithWalkers type or dashboard data — requires adding currentPrice to walker shape in dogsRepo and threading it through to dashboard client. Set-price UI added to dog-profile page (walker card gains inline price form). Dashboard gains a third CTA banner for zero-price state, and a calmer home card when setup is complete.
validation_plan: After each atomic task: run tsc --noEmit and verify zero new errors.
Task 1 (dogsRepo): confirm DogWithWalkers.walkers now includes currentPrice: string. Grep for currentPrice in dogsRepo output.
Task 2 (dashboard): confirm setup-state derivation logic is present. Grep for 'priceIsZero' or equivalent in OwnerDashboardClient.
Task 3 (dashboard CTA): confirm third banner renders for zero-price state; existing no-walker banner is preserved.
Task 4 (dog-profile set-price): confirm setPriceAction is wired to active walker card in DogProfileClient; form is inline and setup-oriented.
Task 5 (status card): confirm calm home card variant is added for setup-complete+no-live-walk state.
Manual smoke: no walker-side files touched. Grep walker/ for any changes — expect zero diff.
risks: currentPrice is NOT NULL in the DB schema — assignWalker always inserts '0.00' as placeholder. So every new assignment starts with zero price; the UI must treat '0.00' as incomplete.
DogWithWalkers.walkers type is shared by dog-profile page too — adding currentPrice there is safe but must be typed consistently.

setPriceAction is already in dashboard/actions.ts (not dog-profile/actions.ts). Dog-profile page must import it from there, or a re-export is added. This is a minor cross-file import but stays within allowed files.
No local QA coverage exists for owner setup states. Validation is type-check + lint only. Residual risk: visual regressions will only surface in preview/production smoke.

Multi-dog owners: setup state is per-selected-dog. If dog 1 is complete but dog 2 has no price, the CTA will correctly show for dog 2 when selected. No multi-dog management logic is added beyond this.
scope_deviations: dog-profile/page.tsx is in the allowed files list implicitly (it's under src/app/owner/dog-profile/[dogId]) but not explicitly named — however it only needs a minor prop addition to thread setPriceAction, which is in scope.
setPriceAction lives in src/app/owner/dashboard/actions.ts. Dog-profile page will import it from there. No new action file created. This stays within allowed files.
follow_up_recommendation: Phase 2 (price enforcement on walker start) can be planned immediately after this task is merged and smoke-tested. The blocked-start logic will need walker-side changes which are explicitly out of scope here.

atomic_tasks.title: Expose currentPrice in DogWithWalkers walker shape
atomic_tasks.change: Add currentPrice: string field to the inline walker type in DogWithWalkers. Add dogWalkers.currentPrice to both getDogsByOwner and getDogById SELECT queries. Cast to string (decimal comes back as string from Drizzle by default).
atomic_tasks.verify: tsc --noEmit passes. DogWithWalkers.walkers[n].currentPrice exists and is typed string.

atomic_tasks.title: Setup-state derivation in OwnerDashboardClient
atomic_tasks.change: Derive activeWalker (first walker where isActive=true) from selectedDog.walkers. Derive priceIsZero = activeWalker exists AND (activeWalker.currentPrice === '0.00' OR !activeWalker.currentPrice). Derive setupComplete = hasActiveWalker && !priceIsZero. Pass setupComplete and priceIsZero to OwnerCurrentStatusCard.
atomic_tasks.verify: tsc passes. No walker-side imports added.

atomic_tasks.title: Add set-price CTA banner to owner dashboard
atomic_tasks.change: Below the existing no-walker CTA, add a conditional: if hasActiveWalker && priceIsZero && !liveWalk, render an amber-tinted set-price banner that links to /owner/dog-profile/[selectedDogId] with a #price anchor or descriptive text. Keep it as a Link, not an inline form — owner sets price on the dog profile page.
atomic_tasks.verify: No inline billing logic added. Banner links to existing dog-profile surface.

atomic_tasks.title: Add set-price form to dog-profile walker card
atomic_tasks.change: In DogProfileClient: for each active walker card, if currentPrice is '0.00' or missing, show an inline price input + submit button. Wire to a setPriceAction prop. In page.tsx: import setPriceAction from dashboard/actions.ts and pass it to DogProfileClient bound with dogWalkerId.
atomic_tasks.verify: Form renders only for active walkers with zero/missing price. tsc passes. No walker-side code touched.

atomic_tasks.title: Calm home state in OwnerCurrentStatusCard
atomic_tasks.change: Accept setupComplete prop. When no liveWalk, no lastCompletedWalk, hasActiveWalker, and setupComplete, render a calm green-tinted ready card: checkmark icon, walker name, subtle reassurance text. This replaces the current generic 'no walk planned' neutral card for the setup-complete case.
atomic_tasks.verify: Existing states (LIVE, ended-recently, home-with-history, no-walker amber) are preserved. New state only fires when setupComplete=true and no history.
